wooCategoryMapping.title: Woo category mapping
wooCategoryMapping.summary: The default Woo information category for one kind of object of one app
wooCategoryMapping.description: A per-type default for the Woo informatiecategorie, keyed by the owning app and its object type. It applies only to an object that declares no category of its own; an object's own category always wins. The value is the resolved TOOI URI and label, so any app can read the row through OpenRegister without calling OpenCatalogi code. Mappings have no lifecycle. OpenRegister has no cross-object unique constraint, so the (app, objectType) pair is kept unique by review and by the tests on the seed data. See openspec/changes/woo-category-mapping-intake.

app.title: App
app.description: The app that owns the object type, for example opencatalogi or decidesk.

objectType.title: Object type
objectType.description: The owning app's schema slug or payload kind the default applies to.

informatiecategorie.title: Information category
informatiecategorie.description: The TOOI URI of the informatiecategorie, a member of the official waardelijst.

informatiecategorieLabel.title: Information category label
informatiecategorieLabel.description: The canonical label of that informatiecategorie, shown beside the URI for review.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the default applies. An inactive row is kept but never used.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Why this default was chosen, and where it came from.
